recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes the remaining stale active references from ActivityDefinition mapping examples while preserving the already-applied ServiceRequest merge; later FHIR-13867 audit work can treat this as supporting evidence rather than requiring another core edit for the same snippets.
issue_request: FHIR-13196 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested clarification of the unclear ProcedureRequest versus ReferralRequest boundary, with the accepted direction to merge the resources and seek feedback on category and transfer-of-care representation.
initial_application: Historical commits 463cb5b344 and 6dc6ae273f merged ReferralRequest into ProcedureRequest and added mapping support; 06bd9f6ffe later renamed the merged resource to ServiceRequest as part of the same change family. Current fhir.ini has ServiceRequest active and records ProcedureRequest/ReferralRequest as merged or retired.
additional_context: FHIR-13867 finalized the ServiceRequest name. FHIR-13195 is the Appointment companion and current Appointment.basedOn already references ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest includes referral and transfer-of-care aliases plus category guidance, but active ActivityDefinition mapping snippets still used retired request-resource names as input target declarations.
reconciliation: Updated source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-notes.xml and the companion activitydefinition-map-*.fhirmap files so each mapping snippet declares the current target resource named by its target StructureDefinition URL, including ServiceRequest instead of retired ReferralRequest/ProcedureRequest.
source_changes: source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-notes.xml: aligned each displayed ActivityDefinition mapping snippet's input target with its current target resource.

source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-map-Appointment.fhirmap and activitydefinition-map-AppointmentResponse.fhirmap: changed stale ReferralRequest/ServiceRequest target declarations to Appointment and AppointmentResponse.

source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-map-CarePlan.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-Claim.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-CommunicationRequest.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-Contract.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-DeviceRequest.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-EnrollmentRequest.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-ImmunizationRecommendation.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-MedicationRequest.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-NutritionOrder.fhirmap, activitydefinition-map-ServiceRequest.fhirmap, and activitydefinition-map-Task.fhirmap: replaced retired or mismatched target declarations with the actual current target resource.

related_jiras.note: Published issue that finalized the post-merge rename from ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest and supports the current naming used in the fix.
Companion Appointment issue resolved by renaming incomingReferral to basedOn in light of the ServiceRequest merge; current Appointment source is already consistent.
